rules.strike_timing: strike picked / entry evaluated at minute 5 of the 15-min round
rules.gate: one call every round at minute 5; the signal picks the side and that side is taken or there is NO TRADE - never the opposite side. Four NOTRADE reasons only: the signal side costs over the price ceiling, the tape vetoes the signal side, the orderbook read fails, or |lean| is below the conviction floor
rules.exits: big-wins mode (Anthony Sep 15 16:56Z: no certain sell time, sell whenever it fits): no profit target and no fixed sell window - the position runs until the proportional giveback trail banks it, the hard stop fires (when it is not inert), or the minute 14 deadline goes flat. Holding to settlement instead of the minute 14 deadline is open for Anthony to choose and is NOT the bot's call
rules.tape_veto: 2-min contract tape of 3c against the signal own side vetoes the round (NO TRADE); it never flips to the other side
rules.trailing_lock: scaled to the gain, not to a fixed number of cents: arms once the live bid reaches 2x the entry (and at least 3c above it), then exits once the bid gives back 40% of the PEAK gain, never below entry + 1c. On a 5c entry a fixed +8c arm was a 2.6x move, which is why the arm is now proportional
rules.conviction_floor: |combined lean| must be at least 1.8 at minute 5, OR at least 1.5 with the historical read agreeing with the side the signal picked at >= 70% over >= 30 matched past rounds (history can only ADD trades in that narrow band - it never picks or flips a side)
rules.settlement: KXXRP15M settles on the simple average of the final 60s of CF Benchmarks' XRPUSDRTI against the 60s average before the open, so the effective decision deadline is minute 14. The bot is always flat by minute 14 - the deadline IS that fact, since a spike inside the final 60s barely moves the settled outcome
rules.price_series: all indicators computed from the XRPUSDRTI settlement index (Kalshi live_data, ~1 tick/s); Coinbase spot is a fallback only and every log line names the source
rules.hard_stop: proportional: 25% of entry, min 8c, max 20c below entry (Anthony's numbers, unchanged) - but on a 3-8c entry there is nothing 8c below, so the level clamps at zero and the stop is INERT: the most at risk is the premium paid, and the log line says so
